name: FreeRCT
blurb: FreeRCT aims to be a free and open source game which captures the look, feel and gameplay of the popular games RollerCoaster Tycoon 1 and 2.
description:
FreeRCT aims to be a free and open source game which captures the look, feel and gameplay of the popular games RollerCoaster Tycoon 1 and 2.

The game is still in an early alpha state, but it is already playable and offers a variety of features.

install.label: Flatpak
install.note: Works on every distribution, sandboxed and kept up to date for you.
